set.body: Purpose: make eyes4s scientific and semantic claims true before adding new algorithmic breadth. Scope: sequence-preserving filters; Engbert-Kliegl kinematics; canonical I-DT; explicit invalid-sample detection; temporal-support occupancy; frame and grid identity conflicts; lawful comparison types; source-reconstructable events; independent validation; clean generated CI; and one real-data AOI workflow. Preserve Machine, Agreement, Sync, Gaze, and the module boundaries unless discriminating evidence requires a change. Exit criteria: exact timestamp preservation; complete labelled or explicitly unclassified temporal support; occupancy mass reconciled to analysable duration; every successful public configuration satisfies its local invariant; same-id different-spec identities fail as corruption; every exported Metric satisfies its laws for every successful configuration; named detector fixtures agree with designated references; intended mutants fail; JVM and Scala.js trust fixtures agree; the ordinary hosted workflow is green; and one real recording reaches tidy AOI results with provenance. I2MC, REMoDNaV, BIDS ingest, dynamic AOIs, and wholesale columnar storage remain deferred unless separately decided.
set.title: Trust milestone: scientific correctness before breadth
